    dist_to_cur = torch.norm(locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)

    dist_from_depot = torch.norm(locs - depot_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)

    dist_cur_to_depot = torch.norm(cur_loc - depot_loc, dim=-1, keepdim=True)

    savings = dist_cur_to_depot + dist_from_depot - dist_to_cur

    proximity = 1.0 / (dist_to_cur + eps)

    prox_max = proximity.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values.clamp_min(eps)
    proximity_norm = proximity / prox_max

    sav_max = savings.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    sav_range = (sav_max - sav_min).clamp_min(eps)
    savings_norm = (savings - sav_min) / sav_range

    load_expanded = load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(eps)
    snugness = (demand / load_expanded).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    snugness_bonus = torch.clamp(snugness - 0.85, min=0.0) / 0.15

    logits = 2.0 * proximity_norm + 2.0 * savings_norm + 0.5 * snugness_bonus

    unvisited_mask = (1.0 - visited)

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

    depot_loc = locs[:, 0, :]

    load_c = load.clamp_min(1e-3)

    rem_after = (load_e - demand).clamp_min(0.0)

    unvisited_dem = demand * (1.0 - visited)

    outstanding_after = (total_outstanding - demand).clamp_min(0.0)

    fits = (demand <= load_e + 1e-6) & (~visited.bool())
    fits_f = fits.float()

    clean_fit = torch.exp(-((slack_norm - 0.05) ** 2) / (2 * 0.10 ** 2))

    waste = (rem_after - outstanding_after).clamp_min(0.0)
    waste_pen = waste / load_e

    first_loc = locs[idx, first_node.clamp(min=0, max=N1 - 1)]
    ang_first = torch.atan2(first_loc[:, 1] - depot_loc[:, 1],
                            first_loc[:, 0] - depot_loc[:, 0])

                           locs[:, :, 0] - depot_loc[:, 0].unsqueeze(1))

    ang_diff = torch.remainder(ang_diff + math.pi, 2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    ang_score = torch.cos(ang_diff - 0.3)

    savings = dist_to_depot[:, 0:1] + dist_to_depot - dist_to_cur
    savings_norm = savings / (dist_to_depot[:, 0:1] + 1e-3)

    cust_mask = mask.clone()

    n_feasible = cust_mask.float().sum(dim=-1)
    locked = ((demand > load_e + 1e-6) & (~visited.bool())).float()

    best_fit = (clean_fit * fits_f).max(dim=-1).values

        1.5 * low_load
        + 1.2 * lock_frac

    )

        4.0 * fits_f
        + 2.5 * clean_fit * fits_f

        + 0.9 * ang_score * fits_f
        + 0.4 * savings_norm * fits_f
        - 0.6 * dist_to_cur * fits_f

RHO = 0.5; FILL = 0

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m_ = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c_ = cust - m_
    cxx = (c_[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c_[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c_[..., 0] * c_[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s_[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    Du = (demand * unv.float()).sum(1); L = load.float()
    k = torch.clamp(torch.ceil(Du - L - 1e-6), min=0.0); gap = Du - k
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    det = d_c + d_0 - d_c[:, :1]
    if RHO > 0:
        theta = RHO * 2.0 * (d_0 * unv.float()).sum(1) / unv.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:
        cheap = torch.ones_like(feas)
    closing = feas & (demand >= (gap - 1e-3)[:, None])
    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))
    on = (current_node != 0) & (Du > 1e-6) & (gap > 1e-3) & feas.any(1) & ok
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    score[:, 0] = -on.float()
    if FILL:
        score = score + (on[:, None] & closing & cheap).float()
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

def _rule_heuristic_L2(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    START = 1; ROUTE = 0; LOOPC = 0.74; KAPPA = 0.5; PROG = 1.0; LANE = 1.0; MEMB = 0.0; MEMB_RET = 0.0; DEPOT = 1
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c = cust - m
    cxx = (c[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c[..., 0] * c[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1); vn = torch.stack([-u[:, 1], u[:, 0]], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s = ((locs - m) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1); t = ((locs - m) * vn.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    sp = ((ss[:, -1] - ss[:, 0]) / N).clamp(min=1e-6).unsqueeze(1)
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    at_dep = (current_node == 0)
    s0 = s[:, :1]; q = demand * unv.float()
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    if START:
        far_j = d_0.masked_fill(~unv, -1.0).argmax(1, keepdim=True)
        fside = torch.sign(s.gather(1, far_j) - s0); fside = torch.where(fside == 0, torch.ones_like(fside), fside)
        dep = fside * (s - s0)
        cum = ((dep.unsqueeze(1) >= dep.unsqueeze(2)).float() * (q * (dep > 0).float()).unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
        mem = unv & (dep > 0) & (cum <= 1.0 + 1e-6)
        b_out = dep.masked_fill(~mem, -1e9).amax(1, keepdim=True); a_in = dep.masked_fill(~mem, 1e9).amin(1, keepdim=True)
        has = mem.any(1, keepdim=True)
        b_out = torch.where(has, b_out, dep.masked_fill(~unv, -1e9).amax(1, keepdim=True)); a_in = torch.where(has, a_in, b_out)
        hh = t[:, :1].abs()
        loop = (torch.sqrt(hh ** 2 + a_in ** 2) + LOOPC * (b_out - a_in)) < torch.sqrt(hh ** 2 + b_out ** 2)
        target = torch.where(loop, a_in, b_out)
        st = -(dep - target).abs() / sp
        score = torch.where(at_dep[:, None] & feas, st, score)
    if ROUTE:
        side = torch.sign(s.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1)) - s0); side = torch.where(side == 0, torch.ones_like(side), side)
        depth = side * (s - s0); dcur = depth.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1))
        cum = ((depth.unsqueeze(1) >= depth.unsqueeze(2)).float() * (q * (depth > 0).float()).unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
        mem = unv & (depth > 0) & (cum <= load.float().unsqueeze(1) + 1e-6)
        outb = (mem & (depth > dcur + 0.5 * sp)).any(1, keepdim=True)
        lane_c = torch.sign(t.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1)))
        same = (torch.sign(t) == lane_c).float()
        o_out = -d_c + PROG * torch.maximum(torch.minimum(depth - dcur, 4.0 * sp), -4.0 * sp) + LANE * sp * same
        o_ret = depth - KAPPA * d_c
        o = torch.where(outb, o_out - MEMB * (~mem).float(), o_ret - MEMB_RET * (~mem).float())
        on = (~at_dep)[:, None] & feas
        nf = on.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        omean = (o * on.float()).sum(1) / nf
        omin = o.masked_fill(~on, float("inf")).amin(1)
        dep_v = omean if DEPOT == 0 else torch.where(outb[:, 0], omin, -KAPPA * d_c[:, 0])
        o = torch.where(on, o, torch.zeros_like(o))
        o[:, 0] = torch.where((~at_dep) & on.any(1), dep_v, torch.zeros_like(dep_v))
        score = torch.where(at_dep[:, None], score, o)
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

    savings = dist_cur_depot.unsqueeze(1) + dist_depot - dist_to_cur

    n_unvisited = (1.0 - visited[:, 1:]).sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1.0)

    total_remaining_demand = (demand[:, 1:] * (1.0 - visited[:, 1:])).sum(dim=1)

RHO = 0.5; FILL = 0

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device

    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape

    depot_loc = locs[:, 0, :]
    cur_loc   = locs[arange_B, current_node]
    first_loc = locs[arange_B, first_node]

    dist_depot_to_nodes = torch.norm(locs - depot_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)
    dist_cur_to_nodes   = torch.norm(locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1),   dim=-1)
    dist_cur_to_depot   = dist_depot_to_nodes[arange_B, current_node]

    savings = (dist_depot_to_nodes
               + dist_cur_to_depot.unsqueeze(1)
               - dist_cur_to_nodes)

    dir_first = first_loc - depot_loc
    angle_first = torch.atan2(dir_first[:, 1], dir_first[:, 0])

    dir_depot_to_cur = cur_loc - depot_loc
    norm_cur = torch.norm(dir_depot_to_cur, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(eps)
    at_depot = (norm_cur.squeeze(1) < eps).float()

    angle_cur_raw = torch.atan2(dir_depot_to_cur[:, 1], dir_depot_to_cur[:, 0])
    angle_cur = (1.0 - at_depot) * angle_cur_raw + at_depot * angle_first

    dir_depot_to_nodes = locs - depot_loc.unsqueeze(1)
    angle_nodes = torch.atan2(dir_depot_to_nodes[..., 1],
                              dir_depot_to_nodes[..., 0])

    angle_diff = angle_nodes - angle_cur.unsqueeze(1)
    angle_diff = (angle_diff + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    angular_coherence = torch.cos(angle_diff)

    angle_diff_first = angle_nodes - angle_first.unsqueeze(1)
    angle_diff_first = (angle_diff_first + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    angular_coherence_first = torch.cos(angle_diff_first)

    load_b = load.unsqueeze(1)

    demand_diff = (demand - load_b).abs()
    exact_fit_bonus = torch.exp(-demand_diff.pow(2) / (2 * 0.15**2))

    low_load = (load <= 0.15).float().unsqueeze(1)

    within_window = (angle_diff_matrix.abs() < (math.pi / 6)).float()
    unvisited = (1.0 - visited)
    cluster_density = (within_window * unvisited.unsqueeze(1)).sum(dim=2)

    w_angular  = 2.0
    w_exact    = 6.0
    w_prox     = 2.0

                    + w_angular * angular_coherence

    w_cluster_depot  = 1.0

import torch.nn.functional as F

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape
    device = locs.device
    N = N1 - 1
    depot_loc = locs[:, 0:1, :]
    cur_loc = locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]
    at_depot = (current_node == 0).float().unsqueeze(-1)

    dist_to_cur = torch.norm(locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)
    dist_to_depot = torch.norm(locs - depot_loc, dim=-1)

    vec_from_depot = locs - depot_loc
    ang_from_depot = torch.atan2(vec_from_depot[..., 1], vec_from_depot[..., 0])
    cur_ang = ang_from_depot[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]

    raw_diff = ang_from_depot - cur_ang.unsqueeze(-1)
    ang_diff = torch.atan2(torch.sin(raw_diff), torch.cos(raw_diff))
    abs_ang_diff = torch.abs(ang_diff)

    demand_norm = demand / demand.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-6)
    load_b = load.unsqueeze(-1)
    capacity_slack = (load_b - demand).clamp_min(0.0)
    fits_well = capacity_slack / load_b.clamp_min(1e-3)

    feasible_customers = mask[:, 1:]
    unvisited_demand = demand[:, 1:] * feasible_customers.float()

    sector_idx = ((ang_from_depot[:, 1:] + math.pi) / (2 * math.pi) * 12).long().clamp(0, 11)
    sector_onehot = F.one_hot(sector_idx, num_classes=12).float()
    sector_pop = torch.einsum('bn,bnk->bk', feasible_customers.float(), sector_onehot)
    sector_demand = torch.einsum('bn,bnk->bk', unvisited_demand, sector_onehot)

    max_pop = sector_pop.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    dominant_sector = (sector_pop == max_pop).float()
    dominant_score = sector_pop + 0.1 * sector_demand
    dominant_sector = (dominant_score == dominant_score.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values).float()
    second_pop = sector_pop.topk(2, dim=-1).values[:, 1]
    pop_ratio = second_pop / max_pop.squeeze(-1).clamp_min(1e-3)
    clear_cluster = (pop_ratio < 0.6).float().unsqueeze(-1)

    rem_customers = feasible_customers.float()
    rem_count = rem_customers.sum(dim=-1)
    rem_demand_total = unvisited_demand.sum(dim=-1)

    rem_ang = ang_from_depot[:, 1:]
    rem_ang_diff = torch.atan2(
        torch.sin(rem_ang - cur_ang.unsqueeze(-1)),
        torch.cos(rem_ang - cur_ang.unsqueeze(-1))
    )
    rem_abs_ang = torch.abs(rem_ang_diff)
    opposite_mask = (rem_abs_ang > 2 * math.pi / 3).float()
    opposite_demand_frac = (unvisited_demand * opposite_mask).sum(dim=-1) / rem_demand_total.clamp_min(1e-6)

    cur_sector = ((cur_ang + math.pi) / (2 * math.pi) * 12).long().clamp(0, 11)
    sector_dist = torch.abs(torch.arange(12, device=device).unsqueeze(0) - cur_sector.unsqueeze(-1))
    sector_dist = torch.min(sector_dist, 12 - sector_dist)
    far_sector_mask = (sector_dist >= 3).float()
    far_pop = (sector_pop * far_sector_mask).sum(dim=-1)
    isolated_frac = far_pop / rem_count.clamp_min(1e-3)

    single_remaining = (rem_count == 1).float()
    rem_cust_dist_cur = (dist_to_cur[:, 1:] * rem_customers).sum(dim=-1)
    rem_cust_dist_depot = (dist_to_depot[:, 1:] * rem_customers).sum(dim=-1)
    detour_ratio = rem_cust_dist_cur / (rem_cust_dist_depot + 1e-6)
    significant_detour = (detour_ratio > 1.6).float()

    depot_return_score = (
        0.8 * opposite_demand_frac +
        0.6 * isolated_frac +
        0.4 * single_remaining * significant_detour
    )

    close_to_depot = (dist_to_depot[:, 1:] < 0.15).float()
    fits_high = (fits_well[:, 1:] > 0.8).float()
    suppress_condition = (close_to_depot * fits_high * rem_customers).sum(dim=-1)
    depot_return_score = depot_return_score * (1.0 - suppress_condition.clamp(0, 1))

    dist_score = -dist_to_cur

    sigma = 0.5
    ang_alignment = torch.exp(-abs_ang_diff / sigma)

    demand_fit_score = fits_well
    capacity_urgency = (1.0 - load_b) * (1.0 - demand / 1.0)

    in_dominant_sector = torch.zeros(B, N1, device=device)
    sector_of_node = ((ang_from_depot[:, 1:] + math.pi) / (2 * math.pi) * 12).long().clamp(0, 11)
    dominant_sector_idx = dominant_sector.argmax(dim=-1)
    node_in_dominant = (sector_of_node == dominant_sector_idx.unsqueeze(-1)).float()
    in_dominant_sector[:, 1:] = node_in_dominant
    cluster_bonus = at_depot * clear_cluster * in_dominant_sector * 0.5

    logits = (
        dist_score * 1.2 +
        ang_alignment * 3.0 +
        demand_fit_score * 0.8 +
        capacity_urgency * 0.5 +
        cluster_bonus
    )

    depot_bonus = depot_return_score.unsqueeze(-1) * 2.5
    depot_bonus = depot_bonus + (1.0 - load_b) * 0.3 * (rem_count / N).unsqueeze(-1)
    depot_penalty = at_depot * 2.0
    logits[:, 0:1] = logits[:, 0:1] + depot_bonus - depot_penalty

    high_load = (load_b > 0.8).float()
    demand_bonus = at_depot * high_load * demand[:, 1:] * 2.0
    logits[:, 1:] = logits[:, 1:] + demand_bonus

    first_ang = ang_from_depot[torch.arange(B, device=device), first_node]
    first_ang_diff = torch.atan2(
        torch.sin(ang_from_depot[:, 1:] - first_ang.unsqueeze(-1)),
        torch.cos(ang_from_depot[:, 1:] - first_ang.unsqueeze(-1))
    )
    first_abs_ang = torch.abs(first_ang_diff)
    first_ang_alignment = torch.exp(-first_abs_ang / 0.7)
    first_node_valid = (first_node > 0).float().unsqueeze(-1)
    first_ang_bonus = at_depot * first_node_valid * first_ang_alignment * 1.5
    logits[:, 1:] = logits[:, 1:] + first_ang_bonus

    sector_density = sector_pop / sector_pop.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-3)
    node_sector = ((ang_from_depot[:, 1:] + math.pi) / (2 * math.pi) * 12).long().clamp(0, 11)
    node_sector_density = torch.gather(sector_density, 1, node_sector)
    density_tiebreak = at_depot * node_sector_density * 0.3
    logits[:, 1:] = logits[:, 1:] + density_tiebreak

    underway_factor = (1.0 - at_depot)
    logits[:, 1:] = logits[:, 1:] + underway_factor * torch.exp(-abs_ang_diff[:, 1:] / 0.4) * 1.0

    _rs = _rule_heuristic_L1(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()
    _fm = mask.bool()
    _X = (logits).float()
    _n = _fm.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1).float()
    _xmean = _X.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _xstd = (((_X - _xmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _rmean = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _rstd = (((_rs - _rmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _spread = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('-inf')).amax(-1, keepdim=True) - _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('inf')).amin(-1, keepdim=True)
    _act = (_spread > 1e-06).float()
    _rz = (((_rs - _rmean) / (0.0 if 0.0 > 0 else _rstd)).clamp(-3.0, 3.0) * _act).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0)
    _rs = _rule_heuristic_L2(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()

    _xstd = (((_X - _xmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _rmean = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _rstd = (((_rs - _rmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _spread = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('-inf')).amax(-1, keepdim=True) - _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('inf')).amin(-1, keepdim=True)
    _act = (_spread > 1e-06).float()
    _rz = (((_rs - _rmean) / (0.0 if 0.0 > 0 else _rstd)).clamp(-3.0, 3.0) * _act).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0)
    _rs = _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()
    _fm = mask.bool()
    _X = (_X + 8.0 * _xstd * _rz).float()
    _n = _fm.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1).float()
    _xmean = _X.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _xstd = (((_X - _xmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _rmean = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _rstd = (((_rs - _rmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]

    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)

    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)

        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:

    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)

    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()

    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c

    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    det = d_c + d_0 - d_c[:, :1]
    if RHO > 0:
        theta = RHO * 2.0 * (d_0 * unv.float()).sum(1) / unv.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:
        cheap = torch.ones_like(feas)
    closing = feas & (demand >= (gap - 1e-3)[:, None])
    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))
    on = (current_node != 0) & (Du > 1e-6) & (gap > 1e-3) & feas.any(1) & ok
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    score[:, 0] = -on.float()
    if FILL:
        score = score + (on[:, None] & closing & cheap).float()
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

RHO = 0.5; FILL = 0

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]

    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)

    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s_[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c

    k = torch.clamp(torch.ceil(Du - L - 1e-6), min=0.0); gap = Du - k
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    det = d_c + d_0 - d_c[:, :1]
    if RHO > 0:
        theta = RHO * 2.0 * (d_0 * unv.float()).sum(1) / unv.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:
        cheap = torch.ones_like(feas)
    closing = feas & (demand >= (gap - 1e-3)[:, None])
    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))

    if FILL:

    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape
    device = locs.device
    eps = 1e-8

    depot_loc = locs[:, 0:1, :]
    cust_locs = locs[:, 1:, :]
    cust_demand = demand[:, 1:]
    cust_visited = visited[:, 1:]

    unvisited = (1.0 - cust_visited)

    cur_loc = locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]
    dist_to_cur_cust = torch.norm(cust_locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)

    dist_to_depot_cust = torch.norm(cust_locs - depot_loc, dim=-1)

    dist_cur_to_depot = torch.norm(cur_loc - depot_loc.squeeze(1), dim=-1)

    remaining_after = load_b - cust_demand
    residual_ratio = remaining_after / load_b

    exhaust_bonus = torch.exp(-(residual_ratio / 0.15) ** 2)
    minimal_use_bonus = torch.exp(-((residual_ratio - 1.0) / 0.15) ** 2)

RHO = 0.5; FILL = 0

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m_ = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c_ = cust - m_
    cxx = (c_[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c_[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c_[..., 0] * c_[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s_[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    Du = (demand * unv.float()).sum(1); L = load.float()
    k = torch.clamp(torch.ceil(Du - L - 1e-6), min=0.0); gap = Du - k
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    det = d_c + d_0 - d_c[:, :1]
    if RHO > 0:
        theta = RHO * 2.0 * (d_0 * unv.float()).sum(1) / unv.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:
        cheap = torch.ones_like(feas)
    closing = feas & (demand >= (gap - 1e-3)[:, None])
    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))
    on = (current_node != 0) & (Du > 1e-6) & (gap > 1e-3) & feas.any(1) & ok
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    score[:, 0] = -on.float()
    if FILL:
        score = score + (on[:, None] & closing & cheap).float()
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

        hh = t[:, :1].abs()

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

import math, torch
RHO = 0.5; FILL = 0

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m_ = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c_ = cust - m_
    cxx = (c_[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c_[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c_[..., 0] * c_[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s_[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    Du = (demand * unv.float()).sum(1); L = load.float()
    k = torch.clamp(torch.ceil(Du - L - 1e-6), min=0.0); gap = Du - k
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    det = d_c + d_0 - d_c[:, :1]
    if RHO > 0:
        theta = RHO * 2.0 * (d_0 * unv.float()).sum(1) / unv.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:
        cheap = torch.ones_like(feas)
    closing = feas & (demand >= (gap - 1e-3)[:, None])
    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))
    on = (current_node != 0) & (Du > 1e-6) & (gap > 1e-3) & feas.any(1) & ok
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    score[:, 0] = -on.float()
    if FILL:
        score = score + (on[:, None] & closing & cheap).float()
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

def _rule_heuristic_L2(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    START = 1; ROUTE = 0; LOOPC = 0.74; KAPPA = 0.5; PROG = 1.0; LANE = 1.0; MEMB = 0.0; MEMB_RET = 0.0; DEPOT = 1
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c = cust - m
    cxx = (c[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c[..., 0] * c[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1); vn = torch.stack([-u[:, 1], u[:, 0]], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s = ((locs - m) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1); t = ((locs - m) * vn.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    sp = ((ss[:, -1] - ss[:, 0]) / N).clamp(min=1e-6).unsqueeze(1)
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    at_dep = (current_node == 0)
    s0 = s[:, :1]; q = demand * unv.float()
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    if START:
        far_j = d_0.masked_fill(~unv, -1.0).argmax(1, keepdim=True)
        fside = torch.sign(s.gather(1, far_j) - s0); fside = torch.where(fside == 0, torch.ones_like(fside), fside)
        dep = fside * (s - s0)
        cum = ((dep.unsqueeze(1) >= dep.unsqueeze(2)).float() * (q * (dep > 0).float()).unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
        mem = unv & (dep > 0) & (cum <= 1.0 + 1e-6)
        b_out = dep.masked_fill(~mem, -1e9).amax(1, keepdim=True); a_in = dep.masked_fill(~mem, 1e9).amin(1, keepdim=True)
        has = mem.any(1, keepdim=True)
        b_out = torch.where(has, b_out, dep.masked_fill(~unv, -1e9).amax(1, keepdim=True)); a_in = torch.where(has, a_in, b_out)
        hh = t[:, :1].abs()
        loop = (torch.sqrt(hh ** 2 + a_in ** 2) + LOOPC * (b_out - a_in)) < torch.sqrt(hh ** 2 + b_out ** 2)
        target = torch.where(loop, a_in, b_out)
        st = -(dep - target).abs() / sp
        score = torch.where(at_dep[:, None] & feas, st, score)
    if ROUTE:
        side = torch.sign(s.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1)) - s0); side = torch.where(side == 0, torch.ones_like(side), side)
        depth = side * (s - s0); dcur = depth.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1))
        cum = ((depth.unsqueeze(1) >= depth.unsqueeze(2)).float() * (q * (depth > 0).float()).unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
        mem = unv & (depth > 0) & (cum <= load.float().unsqueeze(1) + 1e-6)
        outb = (mem & (depth > dcur + 0.5 * sp)).any(1, keepdim=True)
        lane_c = torch.sign(t.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1)))
        same = (torch.sign(t) == lane_c).float()
        o_out = -d_c + PROG * torch.maximum(torch.minimum(depth - dcur, 4.0 * sp), -4.0 * sp) + LANE * sp * same
        o_ret = depth - KAPPA * d_c
        o = torch.where(outb, o_out - MEMB * (~mem).float(), o_ret - MEMB_RET * (~mem).float())
        on = (~at_dep)[:, None] & feas
        nf = on.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        omean = (o * on.float()).sum(1) / nf
        omin = o.masked_fill(~on, float("inf")).amin(1)
        dep_v = omean if DEPOT == 0 else torch.where(outb[:, 0], omin, -KAPPA * d_c[:, 0])
        o = torch.where(on, o, torch.zeros_like(o))
        o[:, 0] = torch.where((~at_dep) & on.any(1), dep_v, torch.zeros_like(dep_v))
        score = torch.where(at_dep[:, None], score, o)
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

import torch.nn.functional as F

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape
    device = locs.device
    N = N1 - 1

    cur_loc = locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]
    dist_to_cur = torch.norm(locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)

    unvisited = (1.0 - visited)
    unvisited[:, 0] = 0.0

    centroid_num = (unvisited.unsqueeze(-1) * locs).sum(dim=1)
    centroid_den = unvisited.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-6)
    centroid = centroid_num / centroid_den

    dist_to_centroid = torch.norm(locs - centroid.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)

    capacity_slack = (load.unsqueeze(-1) - demand).clamp_min(0.0)
    fits_well = capacity_slack / load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(1e-3)

    demand_bonus = torch.where(demand > 0.0, demand / load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(1e-3), torch.zeros_like(demand))
    demand_bonus = torch.tanh(demand_bonus * 2.0)

    depot_loc = locs[:, 0:1, :]
    d_depot = torch.norm(locs - depot_loc, dim=-1)
    saving = d_depot.unsqueeze(1) + d_depot.unsqueeze(2) - \
             torch.norm(locs.unsqueeze(1) - locs.unsqueeze(2), dim=-1)
    saving_to_cur = saving[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node, :]
    saving_to_cur = saving_to_cur / saving_to_cur.abs().max(dim=1, keepdim=True).values.clamp_min(1e-6)

    vec = locs - depot_loc
    angle = torch.atan2(vec[..., 1], vec[..., 0])
    cur_angle = angle[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]
    first_angle = angle[torch.arange(B, device=device), first_node]
    ang_diff_cur = torch.abs(angle - cur_angle.unsqueeze(-1))
    ang_diff_cur = torch.min(ang_diff_cur, 2 * math.pi - ang_diff_cur)
    ang_diff_first = torch.abs(angle - first_angle.unsqueeze(-1))
    ang_diff_first = torch.min(ang_diff_first, 2 * math.pi - ang_diff_first)
    outside_arm = torch.min(ang_diff_cur, ang_diff_first)

    low_load = (load < 0.3).float().unsqueeze(-1)
    very_low_load = (load < 0.15).float().unsqueeze(-1)
    depot_proximity_bonus = low_load * (1.0 - d_depot) * 3.0

    exact_fit = (capacity_slack < 1e-6).float()
    exact_fit_bonus = exact_fit * (4.0 + 3.0 * (1.0 - d_depot))

    small_slack = ((capacity_slack > 0.01 * load.unsqueeze(-1)) & 
                   (capacity_slack < 0.3 * load.unsqueeze(-1))).float() * 1.5

    residual = capacity_slack
    residual_ratio = residual / load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(1e-3)
    near_depot_small_residual = ((d_depot < 0.25) & (residual_ratio < 0.1)).float()
    near_depot_small_residual_bonus = near_depot_small_residual * (1.0 - d_depot) * 5.0

    tiny_residual = (residual < 0.05).float()
    near_depot_tiny_residual_bonus = very_low_load * tiny_residual * (1.0 - d_depot) * 8.0

    abs_small_residual = (residual < 0.1).float()
    near_depot_abs_residual_bonus = low_load * abs_small_residual * (1.0 - d_depot) * 6.0

    far_from_depot = (d_depot > 0.2).float()
    exact_fit_bonus = exact_fit_bonus * (1.0 - 0.5 * far_from_depot * low_load)

import math, torch
RHO = 0.5; FILL = 0

def _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m_ = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c_ = cust - m_
    cxx = (c_[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c_[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c_[..., 0] * c_[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s_ = ((locs - m_) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s_[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    Du = (demand * unv.float()).sum(1); L = load.float()
    k = torch.clamp(torch.ceil(Du - L - 1e-6), min=0.0); gap = Du - k
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    det = d_c + d_0 - d_c[:, :1]
    if RHO > 0:
        theta = RHO * 2.0 * (d_0 * unv.float()).sum(1) / unv.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        cheap = det <= theta[:, None]
    else:
        cheap = torch.ones_like(feas)
    closing = feas & (demand >= (gap - 1e-3)[:, None])
    ok = torch.where(closing.any(1), (closing & cheap).any(1), (feas & cheap).any(1))
    on = (current_node != 0) & (Du > 1e-6) & (gap > 1e-3) & feas.any(1) & ok
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    score[:, 0] = -on.float()
    if FILL:
        score = score + (on[:, None] & closing & cheap).float()
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

def _rule_heuristic_L2(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    START = 1; ROUTE = 0; LOOPC = 0.74; KAPPA = 0.5; PROG = 1.0; LANE = 1.0; MEMB = 0.0; MEMB_RET = 0.0; DEPOT = 1
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape; N = N1 - 1; device = locs.device
    cust = locs[:, 1:, :]
    m = cust.mean(1, keepdim=True); c = cust - m
    cxx = (c[..., 0] ** 2).mean(1); cyy = (c[..., 1] ** 2).mean(1); cxy = (c[..., 0] * c[..., 1]).mean(1)
    th = 0.5 * torch.atan2(2.0 * cxy, cxx - cyy)
    u = torch.stack([torch.cos(th), torch.sin(th)], -1); vn = torch.stack([-u[:, 1], u[:, 0]], -1)
    tr = cxx + cyy; disc = (tr ** 2 / 4.0 - (cxx * cyy - cxy ** 2)).clamp(min=0.0).sqrt()
    ratio = (tr / 2.0 - disc).clamp(min=0.0) / (tr / 2.0 + disc).clamp(min=1e-12)
    s = ((locs - m) * u.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1); t = ((locs - m) * vn.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
    ss = s[:, 1:].sort(dim=-1).values; gp = ss[:, 1:] - ss[:, :-1]
    gap_ok = gp.max(dim=-1).values < 15.0 * gp.median(dim=-1).values
    g = ((ratio < 0.05) & gap_ok).float()
    sp = ((ss[:, -1] - ss[:, 0]) / N).clamp(min=1e-6).unsqueeze(1)
    is_c = (torch.arange(N1, device=device) > 0)[None, :]
    feas = (mask > 0.5) & is_c
    unv = (visited < 0.5) & is_c
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1, 1).expand(-1, 1, 2))
    d_c = torch.norm(locs - cur, dim=-1); d_0 = torch.norm(locs - locs[:, :1, :], dim=-1)
    at_dep = (current_node == 0)
    s0 = s[:, :1]; q = demand * unv.float()
    score = torch.zeros_like(d_0)
    if START:
        far_j = d_0.masked_fill(~unv, -1.0).argmax(1, keepdim=True)
        fside = torch.sign(s.gather(1, far_j) - s0); fside = torch.where(fside == 0, torch.ones_like(fside), fside)
        dep = fside * (s - s0)
        cum = ((dep.unsqueeze(1) >= dep.unsqueeze(2)).float() * (q * (dep > 0).float()).unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
        mem = unv & (dep > 0) & (cum <= 1.0 + 1e-6)
        b_out = dep.masked_fill(~mem, -1e9).amax(1, keepdim=True); a_in = dep.masked_fill(~mem, 1e9).amin(1, keepdim=True)
        has = mem.any(1, keepdim=True)
        b_out = torch.where(has, b_out, dep.masked_fill(~unv, -1e9).amax(1, keepdim=True)); a_in = torch.where(has, a_in, b_out)
        hh = t[:, :1].abs()
        loop = (torch.sqrt(hh ** 2 + a_in ** 2) + LOOPC * (b_out - a_in)) < torch.sqrt(hh ** 2 + b_out ** 2)
        target = torch.where(loop, a_in, b_out)
        st = -(dep - target).abs() / sp
        score = torch.where(at_dep[:, None] & feas, st, score)
    if ROUTE:
        side = torch.sign(s.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1)) - s0); side = torch.where(side == 0, torch.ones_like(side), side)
        depth = side * (s - s0); dcur = depth.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1))
        cum = ((depth.unsqueeze(1) >= depth.unsqueeze(2)).float() * (q * (depth > 0).float()).unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)
        mem = unv & (depth > 0) & (cum <= load.float().unsqueeze(1) + 1e-6)
        outb = (mem & (depth > dcur + 0.5 * sp)).any(1, keepdim=True)
        lane_c = torch.sign(t.gather(1, current_node.view(-1, 1)))
        same = (torch.sign(t) == lane_c).float()
        o_out = -d_c + PROG * torch.maximum(torch.minimum(depth - dcur, 4.0 * sp), -4.0 * sp) + LANE * sp * same
        o_ret = depth - KAPPA * d_c
        o = torch.where(outb, o_out - MEMB * (~mem).float(), o_ret - MEMB_RET * (~mem).float())
        on = (~at_dep)[:, None] & feas
        nf = on.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)
        omean = (o * on.float()).sum(1) / nf
        omin = o.masked_fill(~on, float("inf")).amin(1)
        dep_v = omean if DEPOT == 0 else torch.where(outb[:, 0], omin, -KAPPA * d_c[:, 0])
        o = torch.where(on, o, torch.zeros_like(o))
        o[:, 0] = torch.where((~at_dep) & on.any(1), dep_v, torch.zeros_like(dep_v))
        score = torch.where(at_dep[:, None], score, o)
    return score * g.unsqueeze(1)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape
    N = N1 - 1
    device = locs.device
    eps = 1e-6

    cur_loc = locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]
    depot_loc = locs[:, 0:1, :]

    dist_to_cur = torch.norm(locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)
    dist_to_depot = torch.norm(locs - depot_loc, dim=-1)

    unvisited = (1.0 - visited[:, 1:]).clamp_min(0.0)
    demand_c = demand[:, 1:]
    locs_c = locs[:, 1:, :]

    vec_depot = locs_c - depot_loc
    angle_depot = torch.atan2(vec_depot[..., 1], vec_depot[..., 0])
    angle_depot = torch.remainder(angle_depot + 2 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)

    vec_cur = locs_c - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1)
    angle_cur = torch.atan2(vec_cur[..., 1], vec_cur[..., 0])
    angle_cur = torch.remainder(angle_cur + 2 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)

    cur_vec_depot = cur_loc - depot_loc.squeeze(1)
    cur_angle_depot = torch.atan2(cur_vec_depot[..., 1], cur_vec_depot[..., 0])
    cur_angle_depot = torch.remainder(cur_angle_depot + 2 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)

    diff = angle_depot - cur_angle_depot.unsqueeze(-1)
    diff = torch.remainder(diff + math.pi, 2 * math.pi) - math.pi

    first_vec_depot = locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), first_node] - depot_loc.squeeze(1)
    first_angle_depot = torch.atan2(first_vec_depot[..., 1], first_vec_depot[..., 0])
    first_angle_depot = torch.remainder(first_angle_depot + 2 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)

    direction = torch.where(first_angle_depot > cur_angle_depot,
                            torch.ones_like(first_angle_depot),
                            -torch.ones_like(first_angle_depot))

    inf = 1e9
    masked_angle_min = torch.where(unvisited > 0.5, angle_depot, torch.full_like(angle_depot, inf))
    masked_angle_max = torch.where(unvisited > 0.5, angle_depot, torch.full_like(angle_depot, -inf))
    min_angle = masked_angle_min.min(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    max_angle = masked_angle_max.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values

    sweep_diff = direction.unsqueeze(-1) * diff
    pos_sweep = torch.clamp(sweep_diff, min=0.0)
    neg_sweep = torch.clamp(sweep_diff, max=0.0)
    angular_order_score = torch.exp(-pos_sweep * 8.0) + torch.exp(neg_sweep * 8.0)

    extreme_angle = torch.where(direction.unsqueeze(-1) > 0, max_angle, min_angle)
    extreme_diff = angle_depot - extreme_angle
    extreme_diff = torch.remainder(extreme_diff + math.pi, 2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    extreme_score = torch.exp(-torch.abs(extreme_diff) * 8.0)

    angular_bonus = 5.0 * angular_order_score + 3.0 * extreme_score

    demand_weight = (1.0 + demand_c) ** 2
    demand_score = -dist_to_cur[:, 1:] * demand_weight

    remaining_load = load.unsqueeze(-1) - demand_c
    total_remaining_demand = (demand_c * unvisited).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    ideal_remaining = total_remaining_demand * 0.5
    cap_diff = torch.abs(remaining_load - ideal_remaining)
    cap_fit = torch.exp(-cap_diff * 3.0)
    demand_ratio = demand_c / (load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(eps) + eps)
    consolidation_bonus = 2.0 * demand_ratio

    depot_penalty = (dist_to_depot[:, 1:] * 0.2) * (load.unsqueeze(-1) > 0.7).float()

    remaining_load_after = load.unsqueeze(-1) - demand_c
    last_stop_bonus = torch.exp(-dist_to_depot[:, 1:] * 5.0) * \
                      (remaining_load_after < 0.1).float() * \
                      (load.unsqueeze(-1) < 0.2).float()

    customer_logits = (
        demand_score
        + angular_bonus
        + cap_fit
        + consolidation_bonus
        - depot_penalty
        + 4.0 * last_stop_bonus
    )

    customer_logits = customer_logits * unvisited - 1e9 * (1.0 - unvisited)

    visited_ratio = visited[:, 1:].sum(dim=1) / N
    depot_score = -dist_to_cur[:, 0] + 3.0 * (1.0 - load) + 2.0 * visited_ratio
    depot_score = depot_score - 1.0

    logits = torch.empty_like(dist_to_cur)
    logits[:, 0] = depot_score
    logits[:, 1:] = customer_logits

    _rs = _rule_heuristic_L1(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()
    _fm = mask.bool()
    _X = (logits).float()

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

    cust_vec = locs[:, 1:, :] - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1)

    remaining_after = load.unsqueeze(-1) - cust_demand

    dist_to_depot = torch.norm(locs[:, 1:, :] - locs[:, 0:1, :], dim=-1)

    cust_depot_vec = locs[:, 1:, :] - depot_loc

    is_depot = (current_node == 0).float().unsqueeze(-1)
    ref_node = torch.where(is_depot.bool(), first_node.unsqueeze(-1), current_node.unsqueeze(-1))

    abs_angle_diff_route = torch.abs(angle_diff_route)

    d_cur_cust = dist_to_cur[:, 1:]
    savings = d_depot_cur.unsqueeze(-1) + dist_to_depot - d_cur_cust
    savings = torch.where(is_depot.bool(), torch.zeros_like(savings), savings)

    demand_fit = cust_demand / load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(1e-6)

    exact_fit_bonus = torch.exp(
        -((remaining_after / load.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(1e-6)) ** 2) * 20.0
    )

    small_residual_penalty = (
        (remaining_after < 0.05).float()

    )

        low_load

        * (1.0 - exact_fit_bonus)
        * (savings < 0.5).float()

        low_load

def _rule_heuristic_L2(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):

        o = torch.where(outb, o_out - MEMB * (~mem).float(), o_ret - MEMB_RET * (~mem).float())

        nf = on.float().sum(1).clamp(min=1.0)

        omin = o.masked_fill(~on, float("inf")).amin(1)
        dep_v = omean if DEPOT == 0 else torch.where(outb[:, 0], omin, -KAPPA * d_c[:, 0])
        o = torch.where(on, o, torch.zeros_like(o))

import math
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    B, N1, _ = locs.shape
    device = locs.device
    N = N1 - 1
    cur_loc = locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node]
    depot_loc = locs[:, 0:1, :]
    dist_to_cur = torch.norm(locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1), dim=-1)
    dist_to_depot = torch.norm(locs - depot_loc, dim=-1)

    at_depot = (current_node == 0).unsqueeze(-1).float()
    low_load = (load < 0.15).unsqueeze(-1).float()

    base_weight = 0.3 * at_depot + 1.0 * (1.0 - at_depot)
    logits = -base_weight * dist_to_cur

    logits[:, 0] = logits[:, 0] - 0.5

    remaining_after = load.unsqueeze(-1) - demand
    slack = remaining_after.clamp_min(0.0)
    capacity_penalty = torch.where(
        (load.unsqueeze(-1) > 0.8) & (at_depot > 0.5),
        -torch.abs(slack - 0.1) * 0.2,
        -torch.abs(slack - 0.1) * 1.0
    )
    logits = logits + capacity_penalty

    cur_dist_to_depot = dist_to_depot[torch.arange(B, device=device), current_node].unsqueeze(-1)
    savings = cur_dist_to_depot + dist_to_depot - dist_to_cur
    savings_weight = 0.5 * at_depot + 2.5 * (1.0 - at_depot)
    logits = logits + savings_weight * savings

    delta = locs - cur_loc.unsqueeze(1)
    angles = torch.atan2(delta[..., 1], delta[..., 0])
    ref_dir = torch.where(
        at_depot > 0.5,
        locs[torch.arange(B, device=device), first_node] - depot_loc.squeeze(1),
        cur_loc - depot_loc.squeeze(1)
    )
    ref_angle = torch.atan2(ref_dir[:, 1], ref_dir[:, 0])
    ang_diff = angles - ref_angle.unsqueeze(-1)
    ang_diff = torch.atan2(torch.sin(ang_diff), torch.cos(ang_diff))

    angular_bonus = torch.where(
        at_depot > 0.5,
        torch.abs(ang_diff) * 2.0,
        torch.cos(ang_diff) * 1.5
    )
    logits = logits + angular_bonus

    near_depot_bonus = torch.exp(-dist_to_depot * 3.0) * 3.0 * low_load
    logits = logits + near_depot_bonus

    far_depot_penalty = (dist_to_depot > 0.5).float() * 1.5 * low_load
    logits = logits - far_depot_penalty

    in_current_sector = ang_diff.abs() < math.pi / 3.0
    opposite_angle = ref_angle + math.pi
    ang_diff_opp = angles - opposite_angle.unsqueeze(-1)
    ang_diff_opp = torch.atan2(torch.sin(ang_diff_opp), torch.cos(ang_diff_opp))
    in_opposite_sector = ang_diff_opp.abs() < math.pi / 3.0

    feasible_customers = mask & (torch.arange(N1, device=device).unsqueeze(0) > 0)
    current_sector_feasible = feasible_customers & in_current_sector
    opposite_sector_feasible = feasible_customers & in_opposite_sector
    current_sector_count = current_sector_feasible.float().sum(dim=-1)
    opposite_sector_count = opposite_sector_feasible.float().sum(dim=-1)
    is_sparse = current_sector_count < 2
    has_dense_opposite = opposite_sector_count >= 2
    trigger = (is_sparse & has_dense_opposite).unsqueeze(-1).float()

    opposite_savings = opposite_sector_feasible.float() * savings
    boost_opposite = 2.0 * opposite_sector_feasible.float() + 1.0 * opposite_savings
    logits = logits + boost_opposite * trigger

    penalty_current = 2.0 * current_sector_feasible.float()
    logits = logits - penalty_current * trigger

    logits[:, 0] = logits[:, 0] + 1.5 * trigger.squeeze(-1)

    logits = logits.masked_fill(~mask, -1e9)

    _rs = _rule_heuristic_L1(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()
    _fm = mask.bool()
    _X = (logits).float()
    _n = _fm.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1).float()
    _xmean = _X.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _xstd = (((_X - _xmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _rmean = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _rstd = (((_rs - _rmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _spread = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('-inf')).amax(-1, keepdim=True) - _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('inf')).amin(-1, keepdim=True)
    _act = (_spread > 1e-06).float()
    _rz = (((_rs - _rmean) / (0.0 if 0.0 > 0 else _rstd)).clamp(-3.0, 3.0) * _act).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0)
    _rs = _rule_heuristic_L2(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()
    _fm = mask.bool()
    _X = (_X + 1.0 * _xstd * _rz).float()
    _n = _fm.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1).float()
    _xmean = _X.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _xstd = (((_X - _xmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _rmean = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _rstd = (((_rs - _rmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _spread = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('-inf')).amax(-1, keepdim=True) - _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('inf')).amin(-1, keepdim=True)
    _act = (_spread > 1e-06).float()
    _rz = (((_rs - _rmean) / (0.0 if 0.0 > 0 else _rstd)).clamp(-3.0, 3.0) * _act).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0)
    _rs = _rule_heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node).float()
    _fm = mask.bool()
    _X = (_X + 8.0 * _xstd * _rz).float()
    _n = _fm.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1).float()
    _xmean = _X.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _xstd = (((_X - _xmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _rmean = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n
    _rstd = (((_rs - _rmean) ** 2).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / _n).sqrt().clamp(min=1e-6)
    _spread = _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('-inf')).amax(-1, keepdim=True) - _rs.masked_fill(~_fm, float('inf')).amin(-1, keepdim=True)
    _act = (_spread > 1e-06).float()
    _rz = (((_rs - _rmean) / (0.0 if 0.0 > 0 else _rstd)).clamp(-3.0, 3.0) * _act).masked_fill(~_fm, 0.0)
    return _X + 2.0 * _xstd * _rz
